Seven people, A, B, C, Q, X, Y and Z, are standing in a row, facing north. Exactly three people stand between A and C. Q and A are immediate neighbours of X. None stand to the right of Q. Only Z stands between B and C. Which of the following pairs DOES NOT belong to the same group?

Town L is to the south of Town M. Town N is to the east of Town L. Town P is to the west of Town N. Town Q is to the north of Town P. Town M is to the north-west of Town Q. What is the position of Town P with respect to Town L?

Only three people have exam between B and K. J has exam on some day before D and on some day after H. Only C has exam before K.How many people have exam after I?

In a certain code language,

‘sun moves galaxy’ is coded as ‘lo pi da’,
‘galaxy has star’ is coded as ‘ki na lo’ and
‘sun medium star’ is coded as ‘pi sh na’.

What does the code ‘na’ stand for? 1968

Which of the given options follows the same set of mathematical operations as followed in the two sets?(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)56 - 65 - 75 - 8677 - 86 - 96 - 107441

S, T, U, V, Y and Z live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. U lives on the topmost floor. Only three people live between U and V. T lives on a floor below V. Z lives on an even numbered floor. Y lives on an odd numbered floor but not on floor number 5. How many people live between S and V?2162

Seven people, T, U, V, W, X, Y and Z are sitting in a row, facing north. Exactly five people sit between Z and U. X sits fourth to the right of U. Only Y sits between T and X. V is not the immediate neighbour of T. Who sits fifth from the right of W?705

A statement is given, followed by two assumptions numbered I and II. Assuming everything in the statement to be true, decide which assumption(s) is/are implicit in the statement.Statement: Only dry waste should be disposed in the blue-coloured bins placed on the ground floor.Assumptions:I) There are different coloured bins designated for different kinds of waste.II) Wet waste needs to be disposed of in green-coloured bins.
options: Both assumptions I and II are implicit.
Neither assumption I nor II is implicit.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Only assumption I is implicit.) है।
